summary: Short kerb at a junction with a dwelling 9 m away; no room.
reasons: Residential flats and houses all round

best_section.where: Stanley Terrace kerb just past the Harrys Road junction

drivers.seclusion: Dwellings within 21-27 m on both sides; flats opposite; the 9 m house is at the far end, so exposed.
drivers.access_and_room: Narrow kerb beside a junction with shaded verge and trees; little clear room to pull out of the lane.
drivers.traffic: Through street at a junction with a bus zone; steady passing traffic.
drivers.convention: No cars parked along this stretch; bus zone and no-stopping signs nearby.
